sources.title: Top 50 EMS Companies for 2024 - New Venture Research
sources.effective_period: Page title says 2024; footer says the list is for 2023 and appeared in the March 2024 MMI edition.

sources.note: Industry ranking corroborates first place among the listed global EMS providers. The page has an internal year inconsistency and does not state the ranking metric or the full-market denominator.

sources.title: Hon Hai Tech Day 2024 Opens To Record Attendance Superchip AI Server Capabilities and EV CDMS Strength On Display
sources.locator: Article body: reports new electric-vehicle reference designs and describes CDMS for automotive B2B customers.
sources.note: Official issuer disclosure supports EV/CDMS involvement, not leadership or market share.

sources.title: Hon Hai Technology Group (Foxconn) Announces Second Quarter 2024 Financial Results
sources.locator: Article body: states AI server revenue rose over 60% quarter-on-quarter and exceeded 40% of overall server revenue for the period.
sources.note: Official issuer disclosure supports AI-server business activity; the cited percentage uses Foxconn’s overall server revenue as denominator, not the global AI-server market.
